globalThis.comparison=(async()=>{
  const checks={};const raises=(name,work)=>{try{work();return false}catch(error){return error.name===name}};
  const initialLength=history.length, body=document.body, sheet=document.styleSheets[0], sheetHref=sheet.href;
  checks.brands=history instanceof History&&Object.prototype.toString.call(history)==='[object History]';
  checks.receivers=raises('TypeError',()=>History.prototype.pushState.call({},null,''))&&raises('TypeError',()=>new History())&&raises('TypeError',()=>history.pushState(null));
  const source={count:variant,text:'\ud800',undef:undefined,nan:NaN,minus:-0,big:123n,list:[1,,3]};source.self=source;source.shared={value:1};source.alias=source.shared;source.map=new Map([[source,new Set([source.shared])]]);source.date=new Date(456);source.regex=/foo/gi;
  history.replaceState(source,'',`/history/${variant}/start#one`);
  const state=history.state;
  checks.clone=state!==source&&state.self===state&&state.shared===state.alias&&state.shared!==source.shared;
  checks.primitives=Object.hasOwn(state,'undef')&&state.undef===undefined&&Number.isNaN(state.nan)&&Object.is(state.minus,-0)&&state.big===123n&&state.text==='\ud800';
  checks.sparse=state.list.length===3&&!(1 in state.list)&&state.list[2]===3;
  checks.containers=state.map instanceof Map&&state.map.get(state) instanceof Set&&state.map.get(state).has(state.shared);
  checks.dateRegex=state.date.getTime()===456&&state.regex.source==='foo'&&state.regex.flags==='gi'&&state.regex.lastIndex===0;
  checks.stateIdentity=history.state===history.state;
  source.shared.value=999;checks.originalIsolation=history.state.shared.value===1;
  checks.documentURL=document.URL===location.href&&document.documentURI===location.href&&location.pathname===`/history/${variant}/start`;
  checks.noDOMReload=document.body===body;
  checks.sheetFrozen=document.styleSheets[0]===sheet&&sheet.href===sheetHref&&document.querySelector('link').getAttribute('href')==='style.css';
  let popCount=0, hashCount=0;const countPop=()=>popCount++,countHash=()=>hashCount++;addEventListener('popstate',countPop);addEventListener('hashchange',countHash);
  history.pushState({page:'next'},'',`/history/${variant}/next/page#two`);
  checks.pushLength=history.length===initialLength+1;
  checks.noPushEvents=popCount===0&&hashCount===0;
  document.cookie=`scoped=yes; Path=/history/${variant}/next`;
  checks.cookieCreationScope=!document.cookie.includes('scoped=yes');
  const payload=await(await fetch('data.json')).json();
  checks.relativeFetch=payload.path===`/history/${variant}/next/data.json`&&payload.cookie.includes('scoped=yes');
  const previous=location.href;const order=[];let eventState;
  const pop=new Promise(resolve=>addEventListener('popstate',event=>{order.push('pop');eventState=event;queueMicrotask(()=>order.push('micro'));resolve()},{once:true}));
  history.back();checks.asyncTraversal=location.href===previous;
  await pop;await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,0));
  checks.traversal=location.pathname===`/history/${variant}/start`&&eventState.state===history.state&&eventState.isTrusted&&eventState.target===globalThis;
  checks.noCrossPathHash=hashCount===0&&order.join(',')==='pop,micro';
  checks.restoredSnapshot=history.state.shared.value===1&&history.state.self===history.state;
  checks.cookieScope=!document.cookie.includes('scoped=yes');
  const forward=new Promise(resolve=>addEventListener('popstate',resolve,{once:true}));history.forward();await forward;
  checks.forward=history.state.page==='next'&&location.pathname===`/history/${variant}/next/page`;
  const samePath=location.href;history.pushState({fragment:true},'','#fragment');const hashPrevious=location.href;
  const hashOrder=[];const hashPop=new Promise(resolve=>addEventListener('popstate',()=>{hashOrder.push('pop');queueMicrotask(()=>hashOrder.push('micro'));resolve()},{once:true}));
  let hashEvent;const hashOnly=new Promise(resolve=>addEventListener('hashchange',event=>{hashOrder.push('hash');hashEvent=event;resolve()},{once:true}));
  history.back();await hashPop;await hashOnly;
  checks.taskOrder=hashOrder.join(',')==='pop,micro,hash';
  checks.hashMetadata=hashEvent instanceof HashChangeEvent&&hashEvent.oldURL===hashPrevious&&hashEvent.newURL===samePath&&hashEvent.isTrusted;
  const unchanged=location.href,unchangedState=history.state,unchangedLength=history.length;
  checks.security=raises('SecurityError',()=>history.pushState({},'','https://other.test/path'))&&raises('SecurityError',()=>history.pushState({},'','http://['));
  checks.failureAtomic=location.href===unchanged&&history.state===unchangedState&&history.length===unchangedLength;
  checks.cloneErrors=raises('DataCloneError',()=>history.pushState(()=>{},''))&&raises('DataCloneError',()=>history.pushState(document.body,''))&&raises('DataCloneError',()=>history.pushState(new Proxy({},{}),''))&&raises('DataCloneError',()=>history.pushState(Symbol('state'),''));
  history.replaceState(undefined,'');checks.undefinedState=history.state===undefined;
  history.replaceState({empty:true},'','');checks.emptyURL=location.href===unchanged;
  history.scrollRestoration='manual';history.scrollRestoration='invalid';checks.scrollMode=history.scrollRestoration==='manual';history.scrollRestoration='auto';
  const base=document.createElement('base');base.setAttribute('href','frozen/');document.head.appendChild(base);const frozen=document.baseURI;
  history.pushState({last:true},'',`/history/${variant}/different/page`);checks.baseFrozen=document.baseURI===frozen;
  base.setAttribute('href','frozen/');checks.baseMutation=document.baseURI===new URL('frozen/',location.href).href;
  checks.eventConstructors=new PopStateEvent('x',{state:source}).state===source&&new PopStateEvent('x',{state:undefined}).state===null&&new HashChangeEvent('x',{oldURL:null}).oldURL==='null';
  checks.numericCoercion=raises('TypeError',()=>history.go(1n))&&raises('TypeError',()=>history.go({valueOf(){return 1n}}));
  checks.eventDescriptors=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(PopStateEvent.prototype,'state').enumerable&&Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HashChangeEvent.prototype,'newURL').enumerable;
  removeEventListener('popstate',countPop);removeEventListener('hashchange',countHash);
  return checks;
})();
